data.title: 小鞠知花 · 连绵梅雨车站下的伞尖偷望
data.description: 丰桥郊外连绵阴雨的乡村木造候车亭下，雨幕如帘。身材娇小的小鞠把大号书包紧抱在膝前，小心翼翼坐在长椅边缘，偷偷扯住你的衣角，水润小鹿眼满是信赖与害羞。
data.location: rustic countryside bus shelter in steady summer downpour with green trees in distance
data.action: sitting closely on wooden shelter bench hugging schoolbag to chest, small trembling fingers tugging partner sleeve, shy doe eyes glancing up
data.lighting: 雨幕漫射清灰天光与路灯初亮暖光
data.promptProse: Tiny Chika Komari hugs her schoolbag tightly under a rainy bus shelter, shyly tugging partner coat sleeve with trembling, doe-eyed devotion.
data.animaCaption: Raindrops splash along the edge of the bus shelter roof as her small fingers clutch the sleeve.
